definitions.bytes: raw UTF-8 response body bytes before local JSON serialization; initial POST and last GET measured separately
definitions.endToEndMs: client POST start to final GET body read; includes 4-second polling waits
definitions.serverLifecycleMs: monid completedAt minus createdAt; server-reported, not independent latency
definitions.rawBodySha256: SHA256 of JSON parse then ensure_ascii=False compact separators serialization; not wire bytes
definitions.selectedOutput: Public numeric metrics, times, booleans and field structure only; user handles, usernames, names, content titles and post/account IDs removed. Explicit public brand test inputs and monid receipt runIds retained.
